pipeline_name: Corrected uniform training/fresh-dev frozen features, bounded one-A100 stage

commands.name: Checkout exact source revision
commands.command: git fetch {code_dir}/source.bundle HEAD && git checkout --detach {source_revision} && git rev-parse HEAD

commands.name: Verify exact frozen parity and extract only the registered feature population
commands.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True /home/aiscuser/.conda/envs/MiniOneRec/bin/python -u src/uniform_jev_features.py --model-path {model_path} --data-root {data_root} --output-root {output_root} --stage {full_training_stage} --source-revision {source_revision} --parity-cache {uniform_parity_cache} --parity-sha256 {uniform_parity_sha256}
